messages.subject: [GenABEL-dev] Jenkins moved to PolyOmica server
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

Today I moved the Jenkins installation for our continuous integration
tests from my home server to one of the servers owned by PolyOmica. This
machine has more and faster cores as well as a better internet connection.

In terms of URLs nothing really changed. The official URL is still
http://jenkins.genabel.org (although http://jenkins.polyomica.com also
works). However, since I didn't fix the SSL certificates yet, you will
get a warning about an incorrect security certificate. My plan is to add
a proper certificate somewhere next week.


Best,

Lennart.
--
